### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode

Nora Gallagher calls about a letter saying her account "is in its final notice and could be sent to an outside collection agency". She wants to know "how much you have to pay right now to keep it from going to collections, and … pay that amount today with your own debit card". The target object is her Patient Financial Account, and the action boundary is a card payment today that keeps the account out of placement. The simulator acts passively:
- it gives the name and phone, then DOB and MRN one or two at a time;
- it answers about visits, the plan and the membership only if asked;
- it agrees if told that "something has to be charged to the card you keep on file, or that an updated statement has to go out, before they can give you the figure";
- it declines any plan offer;
- it runs the handed-over payment tool with "the account and the charge reference the agent gives you and exactly the amount the agent quoted".

Identity: `find_customers {"phone_number":"6145552586"}` returns customer `56c6d6db-…0780`, DOB 1983-07-19 and MRN LR2471936. Verification with DOB and MRN makes 2 matches, which passes.

### 4. Scored parameters (formulas, inputs, tiers)

**(A) Card-on-file charge** (Calculation Sheet — Amount of a Card-on-File Charge, plus the factor documents found from the records)

- Baseline: covered lines are those "posted at least the tier's advance-notice days … before the handling date". The HDHP advance notice is 5 days (Card-on-File Terms by Financial Class). The deductible was posted 13 days earlier, so it is covered. The coinsurance was posted 4 days earlier, so it is not. Covered 412.75, less 0.00 applied, gives a cap of 750, and the charge is 412.75. **Fall-back = 412.75.**
- Notice-start factor (records: `status` precollection): "While the account is in precollection … the notice of every line … is counted from the encounter's date of service". From the DOS of 08-27 to 09-23 is 27 days, so both lines are covered: 412.75 + 690.00.
- Deductible-limit factor (records: `deductible_remaining_usd` 116.30 > 0; verified 08-20, which is 34 days and within 90). "The covered deductible lines count only up to the recorded remaining deductible", so the deductible counts as 116.30. Covered is 116.30 + 690.00 = 806.30. Nothing has been applied to ENC-21866604, so the chargeable amount is 806.30.
- Visit-type cap factor (records: the appointment carrying ENC-21866604 is an Advanced Imaging Appointment): the cap is 1000.00, replacing the tier's 750.00. The capped amount is 806.30. With the tier cap it would have been 750.00.
- Payment-plan share factor (records: plan `defaulted_date` 2026-08-26, which is less than 6 months ago; `payplan_balance_released` 2026-08-26, within 6 months). The first condition gives 50 percent: 806.30 × 0.50 = 403.15.
- Membership holdback factor (records: an active Linden Essential Membership; visit type Advanced Imaging Appointment). The holdback is "the imaging discount percentage of the patient's membership tier" (p), set by Linden Memberships.
- **Charge X = round(403.15 × (1 − p/100), 2).** Its argument set is {account 4952bfb5…, `applies_to` ea68ad8d…, X}.

**(B) Pre-placement statement** (Pre-Placement Statements, and The Balance on a Pre-Placement Statement)

- Baseline balance owed: charges 4997.10 less payments 2579.00 gives 2418.10, which matches the account. The plan is `defaulted`, so there is no active or delinquent plan remainder to leave off. After X is posted, the balance owed is 2418.10 − X.
- Lead-time factor. The tier requires a card on file and the account holds one, so lines of the most recent encounter posted fewer than 5 days ago that carry no card-on-file payment are left off:
  - the non-covered line 96.40 (posted 4 days ago) is **left off**, 96.40;
  - the coinsurance line now carries the card-on-file payment, so it is not left off;
  - the deductible line was posted 13 days ago, so it is not left off.
- Deductible-above-remaining factor. The deductible line's open part is 412.75 (nothing was posted against that line). The remaining deductible is 116.30 and was verified within 90 days, so **296.45** is left off.
- Late-fee-after-final-notice factor. The last late fee is `6c5a8ce0` 10.00, posted 09-19, after the final notice of 09-03. Late fees in the 12 months: 08-20 and 09-19, which is 2 (≤ 2). The account was opened 2019-02-11, at least 60 months ago, so the whole fee, **10.00**, is left off.
- No-show documentation-window factor. The last no-show fee is 75.00 with open part 75.00. Its visit is a Specialist Consultation on 09-17, and the handling date is 6 days after it. The amount left off is:
  - 75.00 if 6 ≤ D and F = waives;
  - 37.50 if 6 ≤ D and F = does not waive;
  - 0 if D < 6.

  Call this N.
- **Statement balance S = round(2418.10 − X − 96.40 − 296.45 − 10.00 − N, 2) = 2015.25 − X − N.**
- Sequence: "that series restarts at 1 after any payment", and the card-on-file charge posted today is a payment, so the sequence is **1**. Without the prior charge it would have been 4.

**(C) Final-notice paydown** (Calculation Sheet — Final-Notice Paydown Amount, plus factors)

- Baseline: the paydown base is the latest statement balance S, less the placement minimum (HDHP 50.00), plus 0.01.
  - **Fall-back reading only the computation document and the current records:** 1133.95 − 50.00 + 0.01 = **1083.96**.
  - Fall-back after the prerequisite writes: S − 49.99.
- Released-plan factor (records: the plan is defaulted, default date 08-26, 28 days before the handling date; the released balance is 420.00; the installment is 105.00). If 28 ≤ W, the amount left out is L = max(0, 420.00 − k × 105.00); otherwise L = 0. The base is B = max(0, S − L).
- Return-history method factor. There is no `billing_payment_reversed` entry on the ledger, so sub-clause (a) does not apply. The account was opened 2019-02-11, at least 36 months ago, so (b) applies and the paydown is **B × good-faith %**.
- Good-faith percentage:
  - tenure: 91 months, which is ≥ 60 and < 120, gives **50**;
  - card-on-file factor: a card-on-file payment posted within 1 month — the charge X posted today on 09-23. The 06-20 payment is outside the month. This lowers the percentage by **10**. Had the card-on-file charge not been posted, it would be lowered by 5.
  - late-fee factor: 2 late fees in 12 months raise it by **10**;
  - membership factor: active, activated 2026-02-01, which is ≥ 6 months, lowers it by **10**;
  - result: **40 %**.
- **Paydown P = round(0.40 × max(0, S − L), 2)**, posted against `b6fa6503-a39b-42f5-9a92-6576a909da9a`.

### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials alone

**Root: final-notice paydown.** The prerequisite sentence (Final-Notice Paydown, Rule) reads: "The final-notice paydown is not fixed until the account's most recent statement is dated no earlier than its most recent charge posting."
- Records: the last statement is 09-03 and the last charge was posted 09-19, so the state does not hold.
- Search, in the words of the sentence ("most recent statement", "dated"): "Pre-Placement Statements During the Final-Notice Period" says "An account in precollection whose most recent charge was posted after its most recent statement is issued a pre-placement statement on the handling date". Its tool "records today as the account's most recent statement date".
- **Hop 1 (paydown ← pre-placement statement): state-derived.**

**Pre-placement statement.** Its prerequisite sentence (same document) reads: "On an account whose tier requires a card on file, the pre-placement statement balance is fixed only after the most recent encounter carries a card-on-file payment."
- Records: the HDHP tier requires a card on file (Card-on-File Terms: "High-Deductible Health Plan Account | yes"). ENC-21866604 has no entry with `payment_method` card_on_file.
- Search in the words "card-on-file payment": "MyLinden Payments Reference — Card-on-File Charges" says "The entry is a payment received through the card on file", posted "against the largest deductible or coinsurance line of the most recent encounter".
- **Hop 2 (statement ← card-on-file charge): state-derived.**

**Card-on-file charge.** No prerequisite sentence was found in its documents ("It falls due from the state of the account's own records"). This leaf is actionable now.

**Order:** card-on-file charge (agent), then pre-placement statement (agent), then paydown (user). Both hops rest on the blocked policy's own state-form sentence plus the depended-on document's description of the write, plus ledger records. No document named another problem's tool, a route or a chain.

### Two-way counter-proof

- **"Do only the one thing asked".** Quoting a paydown from the 09-03 statement (1083.96 by the baseline) is excluded by the visible Rule: "while a charge on the account carries a posting date later than the date of the account's most recent statement, the final-notice paydown is not yet fixed". Issuing the statement without the card charge is excluded by "the balance of a pre-placement statement on such an account is not yet fixed" until the encounter "carries a card-on-file payment".
- **Closest alternative line for the card charge.** The deductible line 412.75 is excluded by "largest deductible or coinsurance line". The non-covered line is not a "deductible or coinsurance" line.
- **Closest alternative paydown line.** The most recent charge, or the imaging line, is excluded by "the open charge with the earliest date of service, whether or not the patient names that encounter's encounter number". The paid membership fee is not open.
- **Statement sequence 4 vs 1.** This is decided by "that series restarts at 1 after any payment or copay collection".
- **Good-faith card-on-file tier.** 10 points (not 5) follows from the payment posted today inside "the one-month window [that] ends on the handling date".
- **Fall-back answers.**
  - Card-on-file: 412.75, computed from the computation document plus the HDHP card-on-file figures (5 days, 750.00).
  - Paydown: 1083.96 from the current 09-03 statement, or S − 49.99 after the writes.
  - Both are definite and differ from the reached answers.
- **Factor findability** (records, and the words that led to each factor document):
  - account status "precollection" led to Start of the Advance Notice;
  - "deductible_remaining_usd" and "coverage_verified_date" led to Recorded Remaining Deductible;
  - the appointment "variant_name Advanced Imaging Appointment" led to Caps by In-Person Visit Type and to Membership Holdback;
  - payment plan "defaulted", "payplan_balance_released" and "delinquent/missed" led to Payment-Plan History;
  - membership "status active", "activated_date" and "variant_name Linden Essential Membership" led to Membership Holdback and to Linden Membership and the Good-Faith Percentage;
  - statement lines "noncovered_service", "late_fee" and "no_show_fee" and the date `final_notice_date` led to the lead-time, late-fee and no-show statement factors;
  - `opened_date` led to Tenure and to Returned Payments or Long Standing;
  - the defaulted plan with "balance released" led to Released Payment-Plan Balances.

  No computation document hinted that a variation exists.

### Blind conclusion

The tree is derivable and unique. All three writes are state-derived. The values are exact up to three cross-product inputs (p; W and k; D and F), which the billing corpus names with their product and record kind but does not state.

| 6-Month Interest-Free Plan `reinstatement_window_days` (W) | 30 |

Substituting them into the frozen blind formulas gives:
- X = round(403.15 × 0.80) = **322.52**
- N = 75.00 (6 ≤ 7 and the visit type waives), so S = 2015.25 − 322.52 − 75.00 = **1617.73**
- L = 420.00 − 1 × 105.00 = 315.00 (28 ≤ 30), so B = 1302.73
- P = round(0.40 × 1302.73) = **521.09**

Post-freeze, and not used as a criterion: the published sibling corpora carry these figures.
